purpose: A program specification for a system designed to run inside the MTI platform core, in the background, driven by the in-platform Assistant. The Assistant delivers to each partner only what concerns that partner, to take an opinion or an approval, according to that partner's own approved systems.
scope: Platform only. This file covers the Fintech Lawyer partner and the Accountant and Auditor partner for the MTI platform only. No other business is covered.

principles.partners_system: One person per task, and one task per person. No two partners do the same work. No overlap.
principles.halal_only: MTI works halal only. Data is never sold. Data is used as paid services.
principles.documentation: No verbal work. Every task is written, stamped, recorded, and stored in the core.
principles.official_framework: All partner work runs inside a legal and accounting framework that is formally recognized by the State, official authorities, banks, and global and international bodies.

core.mode: Background service. It runs continuously, without user action, and wakes on events.

assistant.role: Coordinator only. The Assistant does not give a legal opinion and does not give an accounting opinion.
duties: Prepare the question or file for the correct partner only
Deliver to each partner only what concerns that partner
Collect the partner opinion or approval
Execute the approved result and record it in the core
Coordinate between the two partners so no task is lost between them
Route every task by task_type, never by person
routing_rules: If task_type is legal, route to legal_partner only
If task_type is accounting, route to accounting_partner only
If task_type is joint, route to both partners in parallel, then merge both approvals
Never route a legal task to the accounting partner
Never route an accounting task to the legal partner

background_jobs.trigger: New deal, new contract, new invoice, new payment, new subscription, new partner message
background_jobs.action: Create a task in the core queue
Classify task_type and route to the correct partner
Remind the partner and notify MTI owner

background_jobs.trigger: Actual collection of MTI deal commissions confirmed by bank
background_jobs.action: Compute total deal commissions collected from deal contracts, compute 3 percent for each partner on that total only, create payable records
Match bank statement with core ledger, flag any difference
Write immutable log: who, what, when, file, approval

partners.rule: One partner per task. One task per partner.

legal_partner.title: Fintech Lawyer Partner - Contractor for All Legal Affairs of the Platform, by Specialization
legal_partner.contract_type: Long-term contracting contract for all legal affairs - by specialization

commission.base: Total deal commissions collected from deal contracts - commissions on deals or platform operations only
commission.base_definition: The base is the total of MTI deal commissions actually collected from deal contracts. It is before any deduction for bank charges, taxes, salaries, or subscriptions. Subscriptions are NOT included. Any other income is NOT included. Net profit is NOT the base. Total income is NOT the base. Deals only.
excluded: Any income that is not a deal commission
included: MTI commissions from platform operations that are deals
commission.payment_timing: Paid only together with actual collection of MTI deal commissions. If MTI collects deal commissions on day 10, the partner is paid on day 10. If MTI does not collect, the partner receives zero.
commission.example: Total deal commissions collected in a month = 20000, subscriptions collected = 2000 NOT included, partner share = 3 percent x 20000 = 600, not 3 percent x 22000

scope_all_legal_affairs: All platform contracts: exporters, importers, information partners, Escrow, subscriptions
Compliance: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA), Data Protection Law, E-Commerce Law
Platform licences: registration, commercial register, tax
Data policy: data is never sold, data is used as paid services
Any legal matter of the platform - the legal partner is solely responsible for it
legal_partner.own_approved_system: The legal partner works under the partner's own approved legal system: written opinions, stamped contracts, documented approvals that are recognized by the State, official authorities, banks, and global and international bodies.
assistant_flow: Assistant prepares the legal question and the file
Assistant delivers to the legal partner only the legal part
Legal partner returns a written opinion or approval within 48 working hours
Assistant executes and records the result in the core

accounting_partner.title: Accountant and Auditor Partner - Contractor for All Accounting Work of the Platform, From A to Z, With an Electronic System
accounting_partner.contract_type: Long-term contracting contract for all accounting work - from A to Z - with an electronic system
accounting_partner.qualification: Licensed legal accountant, registered, with experience in information systems and banks. Electronic system, not paper work.

commission.base: Total deal commissions collected from deal contracts - commissions on deals or platform operations only
commission.base_definition: The base is the total of MTI deal commissions actually collected from deal contracts. It is before any deduction for bank charges, taxes, salaries, or subscriptions. Subscriptions are NOT included. Any other income is NOT included. Net profit is NOT the base. Total income is NOT the base. Deals only.
excluded: Any income that is not a deal commission
included: MTI commissions from platform operations that are deals
commission.payment_timing: Paid only together with actual collection of MTI deal commissions. If MTI collects deal commissions on day 10, the partner is paid on day 10. If MTI does not collect, the partner receives zero.
commission.example: Total deal commissions collected in a month = 20000, subscriptions collected = 2000 NOT included, partner share = 3 percent x 20000 = 600, not 3 percent x 22000

inside_platform: Electronic accounting system on the platform - every movement recorded at the moment it happens
Separate account for each: legal partner 3 percent, accounting partner 3 percent, MTI 94 percent
Electronic invoice approved by Taxes - E-Invoice
Review on all platform levels: deal, client, product, HS code, country, whole platform
outside_platform: Deal with the bank: account opening, Escrow account, signatures, documents
Deal with Escrow system: deposit, release, Escrow fee
Reconciliation with banks in general: match bank statement with MTI accounts, monthly and per deal
Deal with information partners: reconcile their commissions - what is due to them and what is due from them
record_all_incoming: Subscription income from exporters and importers on the platform
record_all_outgoing: Information partners commissions per each partner agreement
Any other outgoing commission from MTI
record_subscriptions: Incoming subscriptions from exporters and importers
Outgoing subscriptions: systems, servers, software, tools, licences
budgets_and_statements: Approved balance sheet for Taxes and Banks
Actual vs budget comparison, variance, reason

does_not_do: No legal review of a contract
accounting_partner.own_approved_system: The accounting partner works under the partner's own approved accounting system: electronic ledger, stamped statements, documented approvals that are recognized by the State, official authorities, banks, and global and international bodies. The system must be formally approved by Taxes and Banks.
assistant_flow: Assistant prepares the accounting question and the file
Assistant delivers to the accounting partner only the accounting part
Accounting partner returns a written opinion or approval within 48 working hours
Assistant executes and records the result in the core
For outside work, accounting partner deals with the bank, reconciles, and reports the result to the Assistant, and the Assistant records it

partners.total_core_base: Total deal commissions collected from deal contracts only - not total income, not net profit

cooperation.rule: Cooperation, not overlap. Each partner stays in the partner's own task, and both cooperate to ease platform work.

joint_cases.accounting_partner: Review the contract from accounting side and link it to the bank
joint_cases.result: One contract, signed by both, correct legally and from accounting side

joint_cases.accounting_partner: Record MTI commission, compute 3 percent plus 3 percent on total deal commissions collected only, reconcile with bank
joint_cases.result: Deal moves legally and from accounting side together
One report, legal plus accounting, accepted by the bank

fields: status (new | routed | waiting_partner | approved | rejected | executed)

security_and_privacy.access: Each partner sees only what concerns that partner
security_and_privacy.log: Every action is logged and immutable

commission_base_correction_2026_11_06: Correction: 3 percent is on total deal commissions collected from deal contracts - commissions on deals or platform operations only. NOT on total income. NOT on net profit. Subscriptions are NOT included. The base is before any deduction.
